section.heading: Botanical Taxonomic Domains
section.description: Navigate the collection by ecological guild and morphological lineage. Selecting any realm opens the full species directory filtered to that botanical domain.

items.title: Angiosperms & Ornamentals
items.description: Showy dicot and monocot blossoms spanning Rosaceae, Asteraceae, Apocynaceae, and Orchidaceae—celebrated for floral symmetry, nectar chemistry, and pollinator guilds.

image.imageAlt: Symmetrical Orchidaceae blossom illustrating zygomorphic angiosperm petal architecture and labellum

items.title: Tropical Pomology & Fruit Trees
items.description: Evergreen orchard canopies and drupe, pepo, and syncarp producers across Anacardiaceae, Moraceae, Arecaceae, and Myrtaceae anchoring tropical nutrition.

image.imageAlt: Cauliflorous Artocarpus heterophyllus jackfruit compound syncarps emerging from tree trunk

items.title: Ethnobotanical & Ayurvedic Herbs
items.description: Alkaloid-, terpenoid-, and polyphenol-rich species rooted in classical South Asian pharmacopeias, from Tulsi and Neem to Turmeric, Ginger, and Ashwagandha.

image.imageAlt: Aromatic Ocimum tenuiflorum Holy Basil foliage and racemose flower spikes in sunlight

items.title: Hydrophytes & Wetland Flora
items.description: Floating-leaved macrophytes, tidal Sundarbans mangroves, and emergent marsh reeds adapted with aerenchyma tissue, pneumatophores, and waxy cuticles.

image.imageAlt: Floating Nymphaea water lily blossom surrounded by waxy hydrophobic orbicular pads
